title: Verbe 'to be' (am/is/are)
bridge: A taali, m'a ka fɛɛnɛ fɛɛnɛ ni sɛbɛn gaa: 'ser' la 'estar'. A lɔnnikɛlaw, o kɛ fɛɛnɛ n'yɛɛ: 'to be'. Kɔfɛ kɛlɛya, a taali fɛɛ, m'a b'a sɛbɛn 'ser/estar' ma kɛlɛya ka sɛbɛn dɔw dɔw la ka tɔgɔ tɔgɔ, a lɔnnikɛlaw koo fana. Kɛlɛya kelenya, a lɔnnikɛlaw o sɛbɛn b'a laajɛ o tɛ: o bɛɛ n'a ta ye 'I am', 'you are', 'he is', n'i fɛɛ.
rule: Verbe 'to be' an ka tugu kɛlɛya la, a yɛɛ sɛbɛn fɛɛ: 'am' (ma 'I'), 'is' (ma 'he, she, it') la 'are' (ma 'you, we, they'). Alaaga bɛɛ, o bɛɛ n'a tɛɛrɛ ka tugu kɛlɛya: 'Are you...?', 'Is he...?'. Alaaga bɛɛ, o bɛɛ n'a tɔɔrɔ 'not': 'I am not', 'he is not' (alaaga lo 'he isn't'), 'they are not' (alaaga lo 'they aren't').

concept_examples.translation: Anw ka tugu bɛ yɛrɛ fɛɛnɛ fɛ.
A maa bɛ hun taa? (sɔrɔkɛla: A bɛ hun taa?)

common_error.explanation: A taali, m'a b'a yɛɛ 'Estoy cansado' o sɛbɛn fɛɛnɛ fana o tɛ, nka, a lɔnnikɛlaw, verbe 'to be' b'a tɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔnin lo. O sɛbɛn 'am/is/are' b'a laajɛ o tɛ.

examples.note: M'a b'a sɛbɛn 'am' ma 'I' fana.

examples.translation: A ka jɛnɛ bɛ dɔgɔtɔra ye.
examples.note: M'a b'a sɛbɛn 'is' ma sɛbɛn kanu bɛɛ fana.

examples.translation: Anw ka tugu o bɛ yɛrɛ fɛɛnɛ fɛ.
examples.note: Alaaga lo 'aren't' bɛɛ b'a sɛbɛn dɔnkɔrɔnin lo.

examples.translation: A ka muso bɛ a ka sɔrɔtɔrɔbɛɛ?
examples.note: M'a b'a tɛɛrɛ ka tugu kɛlɛya alaaga bɛɛ.

title: Jògòkuran tɛmɛ jɔgɔ (Ayɛ, i, a, an, ali, afɛ, ala)
bridge: Tɛmɛyɔrɔw la, jògòkuran tɛmɛ jɔgɔ ka sira kanu: ayɛ, i, a, an, ali, afɛ, ala. Kɔrɔsiw bɛɛ, tɛmɛyɔrɔw kanbɛn, i kɛ fana jògòkuran tɛmɛ jɔgɔ bɛ sira kanu, nka tɔgɔ, a tɛmɛ bɛɛ ka kanbɛn i jògòkuran tɛmɛ jɔgɔ bɛ sira kanu: 'Ayɛ ka jɛn ka taa' (tɛmɛyɔrɔw kanbɛn 'jɛn ka taa'). Kɔrɔsiw fana, tɛmɛyɔrɔw kanbɛn 'he' la 'she' bɛ yɛrɛtɔ la jɔn ka sira kanu, tɛmɛ bɛɛ kɔnɔ, jɔn ka sira kɔrɔsiw.
rule: Tɛmɛyɔrɔw jògòkuran tɛmɛ jɔgɔ bɛɛ: ayɛ (ayɛ), i (i/anw/afɛ), a (a), an (an), ali (ali), afɛ (afɛ), ala (ala). 'It' ka tɔgɔ a ye kɛ fana tɔgɔ la tɔɔrɔ, hayakekaw la tɔɔrɔ, ala kɔrɔsiw. 'You' ka tɔgɔ a ye kɛ fana tɔgɔ la tɔɔrɔ, hayakekaw la tɔɔrɔ. Tɛmɛyɔrɔw kanbɛn, jògòkuran tɛmɛ jɔgɔ bɛɛ tɔgɔ.

common_error.correct: He is a teacher. / She is a teacher.
common_error.explanation: Tɛmɛ bɛɛ ka kanbɛn 'A ye tɛmɛyɔrɔ' jògòkuran tɛmɛ jɔgɔ bɛ sira kanu, nka tɔgɔ, tɛmɛyɔrɔw kanbɛn jògòkuran tɛmɛ jɔgɔ bɛ sira kanu. Tɛmɛyɔrɔw bɛɛ tɔgɔ 'He is...' la 'She is...'.

examples.note: Kalan jògòkuran tɛmɛ jɔgɔ kanu.
Kalan jògòkuran tɛmɛ jɔgɔ kɔrɔbaw la kɔrɔbaw kɔrɔ.
Tɔgɔ la tɔɔrɔ, hayakekaw la tɔɔrɔ.

levels.label: Using 'it' for objects
levels.translation: 'It' ka tɔgɔ a ye kɛ fana tɔgɔ la tɔɔrɔ

examples.note: 'It' ka tɔgɔ a ye kɛ fana tɔgɔ la tɔɔrɔ, hayakekaw la tɔɔrɔ, ala kɔrɔsiw.

title: Kanbali (a/an, the)
bridge: Sipanikɛlaw bɛ kanbali bɛ se kaɲa: 'un/una' (sɔrɔnin kanbali) yɛɛ 'el/la/los/las' (kɛlɛkan kanbali). Kɛlɛya la kaɲa bɛ yɛ: aŋkaloŋo fɛ, i sɔrɔ kɔnɔna kaɲa bɛ se kaɲa (i tun tɛ 'The life is beautiful' o). Kɔnɔna, ma kanbali kaɲa bɛ se kaɲa bɛ yɛ: 'I am a teacher' (sipanikɛlaw bɛ se kaɲa bɛ yɛ: 'Soy profesor' kanbali tɛ).
rule: I kaɲa 'a' bɛ yɛ ma taa kaɲa bɛ yɛ a bɛ fɔlɔ kɔnɔna kaɲa (a book, a car). I kaɲa 'an' bɛ yɛ ma taa kaɲa bɛ yɛ a bɛ fɔlɔ ali kaɲa (an apple, an hour — 'h' kaɲa tɛ). I kaɲa 'the' bɛ yɛ ma taa kaɲa bɛ yɛ a bɛ fɔlɔ kɛlɛya kaɲa wala a kaɲa bɛ yɛ a bɛ fɔlɔ kɛlɛya kaɲa. I sɔrɔ kɔnɔna kaɲa bɛ se kaɲa bɛ yɛ: 'Love is important', i tun tɛ 'The love'.

common_error.explanation: Sipanikɛlaw bɛ se kaɲa bɛ yɛ: 'Soy profesor' kanbali tɛ. Aŋkaloŋo fɛ, i kaɲa 'a' wala 'an' bɛ yɛ ma taa kaɲa bɛ yɛ a bɛ fɔlɔ kɔnɔna kaɲa.

examples.note: I kaɲa 'a' bɛ yɛ ma taa kaɲa bɛ yɛ a bɛ fɔlɔ kɔnɔna kaɲa.
I kaɲa 'an' bɛ yɛ ma taa kaɲa bɛ yɛ a bɛ fɔlɔ ali kaɲa.
I kaɲa 'the' bɛ yɛ ma taa kaɲa bɛ yɛ a bɛ fɔlɔ kɛlɛya kaɲa wala a kaɲa bɛ yɛ a bɛ fɔlɔ kɛlɛya kaɲa.
Kɔnɔna kaɲa bɛ yɛ, i sɔrɔ kɔnɔna kaɲa bɛ se kaɲa bɛ yɛ: 'the'.

title: Jɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn bɛɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn tɔgɔ
bridge: Espaañɛ kan, jɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn bɛnna o bɛɛ -s nɔɔrɔ la a kun (casa → casas, reloj → relojes). Angɛlɛ kan bɛɛ minw bɛɛ, jɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn bɛnna o bɛɛ -s (book → books), nka, a bɛɛ ka tɔgɔ bɛɛ ka kan: sɔrɔla bɛɛ ka kɔfɛ ka bɛ -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z bɛnna o bɛɛ -es (bus → buses, watch → watches). A bɛɛ ka tɔgɔ bɛɛ ka kan: child → children, foot → feet, o bɛɛ ka tɔgɔ minw ka kɛra a ka tɔgɔw bɛɛ ka kan.
rule: Jɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn tɔgɔ: 1) Bɛnna -s (cat → cats). 2) Bɛnna -es sɔrɔla bɛɛ ka kɔfɛ ka bɛ -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z (box → boxes, dish → dishes). 3) Sɔrɔla bɛɛ ka kɔfɛ ka bɛ -y kɛ ka diiman-kafo bɛnna -y ka -ies (city → cities). 4) Sɔrɔla bɛɛ ka kɔfɛ ka bɛ -f nɔɔrɔ la a kun bɛnna -ves (wolf → wolves, knife → knives). Bɛɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn tɔgɔ: child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, man → men, woman → women, mouse → mice, sheep → sheep (ka tɔgɔw ye), fish → fish (ka tɔgɔw ye).

common_error.explanation: Espaañɛ kan, jɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn bɛɛ bɛɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn (niño → niños), nka Angɛlɛ kan 'child' bɛɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn 'children'. A bɛɛ ka tɔgɔw ye minw ka kɛra a ka tɔgɔw bɛɛ ka kan.

examples.note: Jɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn bɛɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn -s bɛnna.
Sɔrɔla bɛɛ ka kɔfɛ ka bɛ -x bɛnna -es.
Jɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn bɛɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn a ka tɔgɔw bɛɛ ka kan (a → e).
Jɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn bɛɛn-jɛnnɔgɔn a ka tɔgɔw ye.

title: Presente simple (I eat, you eat, he eats)
bridge: Sipaniladenw, mɛn kɛ presente simple la donkilifɛnw tile: 'Yo como pizza todos los días'. A b'an bɛ angaleŋɛ la, amma a tun kɛ fɛn fana: tilekuyakuyara (he, she, it) tun bɛ se ka -s ka kɛ verbew la (he eats, she works). Mɛn bɛ se ka 'do/does' ka kɛ mɛn bɛ y'a kɛ fɔlɔw la, sɛbɛn mɛn kɛ '¿...?' kɛ intonacionw la, amma a bɛna mɛn kɛ fɔlɔw la.
rule: Presente simple bɛ se ka verbew tilekuyakuyara (he, she, it) fana, o bɛ se ka -s ka kɛ (o -es sɛ verbew bɛ se ka -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z la). Mɛn bɛ se ka 'do' (kɛ I, you, we, they la) o 'does' (kɛ he, she, it la) + verbew tile (bɛ se ka -s). Tile: 'I eat', 'He eats', 'Do you eat?', 'She doesn't eat'.

concept_examples.translation: Mɛn bɛna ka 8 hɔrɔ la mɛn bɛna ka tɛmɛ.
A bɛna ka spitali la a bɛna ka tilɛ.
I kɛra ka kafe bɛɛ fana?

common_error.explanation: Sipaniladenw, tilekuyakuyara (él) man bɛna ka verbew presente la (él come), amma angaleŋɛ la, a bɛna ka -s ka kɛ (he eats). A bɛna mɛn ka hakɛw tilekuyakuyara (él) la.

examples.note: Verbew tile.

examples.original: She reads a book every day.
examples.translation: A bɛna ka tɛmɛ tilibɔn tilɛ.
examples.note: Mɛn bɛ se ka -s ka kɛ verbew la.

examples.translation: A bɛna ka tilɛ bɛɛ fana?
examples.note: 'Does' + tilekuyakuyara + verbew tile (bɛ se ka -s).
Mɛn bɛ se ka 'don't' + verbew tile.

translations.bm: Presente simple (I eat, you eat, he eats)
